focus: Frontier node F-1-004 (depth 1, scope .skilled/skills/system-deep-loop/runtime/scripts/fanout-run.cjs, .skilled/skills/system-deep-loop/runtime/lib/deep-loop/executor-config.ts): Cross-CLI parity: where do cli-claude-code, cli-opencode, cli-codex, cli-pi, cli-devin, cli-cursor, cli-deepseek-harness and cli-mistral-vibe lineages still differ in permissions, effort flags, failure classes, resume and log shape, and what single executor contract would remove the differences?
noveltyJustification: All five findings are new: the parity matrices exist but two derived facts and one adapter contract are never published.
keyQuestions: Where do the cli-claude-code, cli-opencode, cli-codex, cli-pi, cli-devin, cli-cursor, cli-deepseek-harness and cli-mistral-vibe lineages still differ in permissions, effort flags, failure classes, resume and log shape, and what single executor contract would remove the differences?
ruledOut: Log shape as a parity gap

label: The shared executor contract is half-published: EXECUTOR_PREVENTIVE_SANDBOX_CAPABILITY knows whether a kind really confines, but effectiveConfig and the preview print only sandboxMode/permissionMode, so pi, devin and vibe show a sandbox they do not enforce.

reasoningEffort is accepted by the schema for every kind but rejected for cursor, devin and vibe, so one --executors matrix that sets effort fails on the kinds that bake the tier into the model id; accept it, map it per adapter, and report effortApplied with a warning.

The shared fan-out worker keeps kind-specific failure branches for pi, dsh and vibe instead of carrying exitPolicy and completionValidator on the adapter table, so every new kind must edit the worker.

Six of the eight single-executor YAML branches in each of deep-research.yaml and deep-review.yaml are the same dispatch-iteration.cjs command with a different --executor value, so they can collapse to one branch plus the dsh and vibe special cases.

Log shape and resume are already uniform across kinds, but native is a fan-out kind that cannot start on OpenCode v2, so the matrix is host-version-dependent; remove it from the adapter table or reject it in preflight.

question: Can the effective-config envelope become the single preflight contract that fails a matrix before spawn when a requested effort, sandbox or web-search policy cannot be honored?
Does dispatch-iteration.cjs already accept every executor kind as a value, so the six duplicated YAML branches can collapse into one without losing the per-kind notes?

direction: Unifying log shape or per-kind resume flags
reason: Every kind already writes the same rotated fanout-lineage.out/.err pair and resumes through readStoredLineageSessionId, so there is nothing to unify on those axes.
